practice.title: Practice data
practice.sub: Sample customers, orders, couriers and claims to practise with for the first days. Nothing here reaches a real customer, courier or the ERP.

card.title: Practice mode
card.lead: While it is on, the shop holds sample data like the demo, marked Practice. Nothing is sent: no courier booking, no messages, no ads feed, no ERP.
card.guard: Owner only · switching it off hides practice records from reports and lists, it does not remove them

practice.kept: Products you uploaded yourself ({n}) are never removed by a reset.

reset.title: Reset practice data
reset.lead: Removes every practice record and leaves a clean store. Real orders, customers and the products you uploaded stay.
reset.backup: Take a backup first if you are not sure (Settings › System › Backups).

practice.ownerOnly: Only the owner can use this page.

errors.OWNER_ONLY: Only the owner can do this.
errors.RESET_HIDDEN: Reset is switched off for this shop.
errors.PIN_NOT_SET: The owner has not set a PIN yet.
errors.PIN_LOCKED: Too many wrong tries. Wait a while.
